title: Public OKF bundle access
scope: Thirteen public, owner-authored okf-* GitHub repositories; excludes private repositories, local non-repositories and the upstream specification fork. Supplemental discovery metadata; not an OKF core extension or a Reader admission decision.
verification: The initial directory observation was 14 November 2026. Later per-entry records identify exact checks and dates; the owner candidate catalogue is discovery evidence. Full record coverage and browser checks are accepted only where the entry says so. Live ChatGPT Voice use is not verified. Pinned raw fallbacks require matching complete descriptor digests.

Its own desktop/mobile walkthrough, explicit producer bundle, real graph click and source link passed in Chrome. All release assets and 169 archive members were downloaded and reverified.
